headline: Black Luster Soldier
title: Black Luster Soldier Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Black Luster Soldier. What is it? It is a Level eight EARTH Warrior Ritual Monster with three thousand attack. What does it do? It is a Ritual Monster, so you Ritual Summon it with the spell Black Luster Ritual. How do you use it? You need Black Luster Ritual and monsters to tribute whose Levels add up to eight or more. It is in Starter Deck: Yugi Evolution. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
